_note: Roads (RoadNet plans them, ZoneRoads lays them; cg_brief queue item 1.2). Every number here is Proposed. kinds: width_m (carriageway), colour (hex: the surface), far_colour (the terrain's tint under and past the drawn road), friction (the road body's PhysicsMaterial: Vehicle reads no surface grip yet, F-191), hard (footsteps: true = the hard-ground steps), max_grade (steepest the profile is let run before it cuts or fills, rise over run), lines (asphalt markings: centre dashes and edge lines). sites: which kind of road a site link gets by the module's base type (both ends' kinds: the better one wins, a town always asphalt; types not listed take default / default_hot). trails: the cross-country trails' kind. crossings: a road out of a linked-zone crossing is asphalt when the link's hash falls under asphalt_share, else dirt (the same on both sides of the link).
